spans.text: Attendolls are special humanoid constructs that are built to primarily protect and serve those who are wealthy. They can be designed to resemble humanoids of many types (though they struggle with the bestial anatomy of creatures sure as dragonkin, birdfolk, capy’hado, etc.) and any gender, which they convincingly pass as. Particularly expensive ones can have realistic skin, scales, fur, etc. to appear authentic. The rich may purchase them as a personal ethics-free service staff, waiters, maids, or anything their creators can program them to do. They are sworn to serve and protect those who commission them (their clients).
The attendoll does not require food, air, drink or sleep.
